verdict.rationale: Gusto documents its own ability to pay international contractors (gusto-docs-7), and it offers a day-one business bank account (gusto-docs-25). That covers sending money abroad in a payroll context. Nothing in the evidence addresses settlement speed, and the only speed claim is same-day pay for off-cycle domestic payroll, which is far from sub-minute. Missing for 10: any evidence that cross-border transfers arrive in under a minute, general (non-contractor) international transfers from the bank account, and independent or hands-on corroboration of international payment delivery times.
